Overview

Toll-Free Number, explained

A toll-free number makes it free for customers to call you, which removes one more reason not to pick up the phone. It also gives a small business a national, established presence.

Your number can ring any phone, team or location, with different rules for business hours, after hours and holidays.

Who it's for

  • Businesses selling nationally
  • Service businesses relying on phone enquiries
  • Businesses with staff in several locations
  • Companies advertising a phone number

Why it matters

Why Toll-Free Number matters for your business

A free-call number removes a small barrier that stops some customers calling. It also gives your business a national, established presence.

Toll-free numbers can only be called free from within Australia, so they suit businesses selling to Australian customers.

Your number can ring any phone or team, with rules for business hours, after hours and holidays.

How it works

From first call to done, in four steps

  1. Needs check

    We look at how customers contact you and where calls get missed.

  2. Fixed quote

    Numbers, features and call flows, quoted in writing.

  3. Setup

    We configure everything and move existing numbers where possible.

  4. Go live & support

    We test with you, then stay on hand to adjust.

Pricing

What affects the cost of Toll-Free Number

  • How many numbers and users you need
  • Whether you're keeping existing numbers or getting new ones
  • Call flow complexity, such as menus, queues and after-hours rules
  • Handsets, if you want desk phones
  • For customer care: the hours, channels and call volumes to cover

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

FAQ

Toll-Free Number questions

Can we keep the number if we move offices?

Yes. The number isn't tied to a location.

Can calls go to different staff at different times?

Yes. We set up time-based routing.

Can we track calls from ads?

Yes. Call reports help you see when and how often customers call.

Is this available outside Australia?

Ask us about availability in your country.

Can calls ring several phones at once?

Yes. We can ring a group at the same time or in order.

Can international customers call it?

Toll-free numbers are for callers within Australia. International customers can WhatsApp us or use another number.

Can we display it in ads?

Yes, and you can track calls from campaigns.

Is there a setup fee?

Costs are itemised in your written quote.
